source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue the previously selected Direction A, the oriented Markov tree. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT inspected live upstream main after the first oriented-tree layer had been accepted as PR #292 and chose the next representation step: align the accepted oriented Markov path convention with the accepted Stern-Brocot convention. The accepted MarkovTree.follow executes Boolean directions from the head of the list, whereas SternBrocot.pair recursively obtains a child by prepending a direction to an existing path. Reversing the Stern-Brocot path makes these recursions agree. The new module defines sternNode and sternMoves using that reversal, proves that prepending a Stern-Brocot direction is exactly one forward Markov child step, proves the corresponding non-backtracking Vieta move is appended to the move encoding, and identifies equality of Stern-Brocot node positions with equality of those oriented Markov move encodings. The development deliberately stays at the combinatorial path/tree-position level: it does not claim that different paths reach different numerical Markov triples and makes no injectivity claim about Markov-number labels, preserving the Frobenius/Markov uniqueness boundary. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and API and authored the Lean statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
